crossRefs.note: For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on…
Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek…

translations.web: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
translations.bsb: Does the plowman plow for planting every day? Does he continuously loosen and harrow the soil?
translations.kjv: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
translations.asv: Doth he that ploweth to sow plow continually? doth he continually open and harrow his ground?
